mutator.name: libredwg_dxf_uaf_llm01_objects_value_line
mutator.strategy: DXF OBJECTS section: replace a Seed-selected code-0 record value line with a Seed-derived random unrecognized name; if OBJECTS is absent, insert 0/SECTION + 2/OBJECTS + 0/random + 0/ENDSEC before 0/EOF; keep the libFuzzer default mutator at 50%.

biases.code_hint: Locate code 2/value OBJECTS, randomly choose one code-0 record before 0/ENDSEC, and replace only the value line after that group code; if OBJECTS is absent, insert the complete SECTION/OBJECTS/random/ENDSEC block before 0/EOF.
biases.basis: mutations[0].target_part=value_line; operation=ensure_record_structure; locator.pick=random_k; construct.when=section_absent; new_value_policy=random_unrecognized_name; preserve=group_code_digits, CRLF, section_terminator(ENDSEC)

limits: Only mutation action a001 from the frozen plan is implemented; no additional strategy was added.
OBJECTS section detection first looks for code 2 / value OBJECTS, then falls back to any trimmed OBJECTS line. Candidate selection assumes DXF two-line group-code/value records.

If OBJECTS exists but has no code-0 candidate or MaxSize is insufficient, the feature returns the original input as the specified failure path. If OBJECTS is absent and insertion cannot fit, it falls back to LLVMFuzzerMutate.
Replacement preserves the original line terminator bytes; inserted structures use CRLF. Random name length is capped by available MaxSize, otherwise 1..64.
The plan gives a byte offset for 0/EOF insertion, but this implementation locates 0/EOF by record parsing rather than trusting that offset.
